title: AET-B-1: the seat roster -- identity bindings only, the seat-field ratchet, declaration-consistency; permissions and time excluded by an enumerated guard
objective: Give the AET runtime its first substrate artifact: a governed roster binding operating seats to contract roles, with delegations ratcheted to name their seat and checked for declaration-consistency -- while a two-shape guard keeps every other doctrine-declared component of authority OUT of the roster.
business_value: AET-B's first governed rung; replaces tribal seat knowledge with an artifact; the referent #261's identity split will consume.
in_scope: badf/seats.json: the six operating seats bound to docs/14 SS3 roles (coordinator, builders, verifier, independent reviewer) with charter provenance refs; the librarian seat recorded VACANT out loud (non-coverage stated, never implied)

schemas/seats.schema.json + gate validation in validate_repo (one canonical gate): schema conformance AND the two-shape guard -- any permission-shaped key (allowed_paths/allowed_tools/actions/permissions/prohibited) or time-shaped key (expires/expiry/until/valid_until/window/time_window) anywhere in a seat entry is refused as AUTHORITY_CONFLICT

scripts/badf_gate.py: _check_delegations gains the F1 ratchet -- delegations in WPs at/above WP-2026-0130 (sentinels exempt) must carry seat, and any declared seat must exist in the roster (declaration-consistency, labeled as such); grandfathered delegations counted; a BADF SEAT ROSTER line in repo output stating seats, vacancy, and delegation-coverage counts
tests/test_badf_seat_roster.py red-first; badf/demands/BADF-DEM-0117.json; GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md doctrine; reconcile WP-2026-0121; composition record + typed G07 self-dossier
out_of_scope: expiry and every time-shaped property (F4: decided in the #261 round with the docs/03 time-window question stated to the operator); identity VERIFICATION (F2: the refusal lands with #261's structural referent); the durable-effect record (AET-B-2); badf/team.yaml (INIT-rung); any authority-matrix, lifecycle, or registry change
acceptance_criteria: seats.json exists, schema-validates, names six seats with the librarian VACANT stated; repo output carries the BADF SEAT ROSTER line with seat and coverage counts
a seat entry carrying a permission-shaped key is refused red-first; a time-shaped key likewise -- BOTH guard shapes constructed and observed failing (the F4 lesson made mechanical)

a delegation at/above the threshold without a seat field is refused at assembly and RED in repo, each naming the WP; the grandfathered delegation is counted, never refused; a declared seat absent from the roster is refused (declaration-consistency, labeled)

the frame-check: every component of docs/03's authority tuple (actor/role, action, target, environment, time window, work package, conditions) is enumerated in the doctrine section with its home artifact named -- none lands in the roster silently (the #270 clause applied to the frame, not only the object)
all pre-existing tests green; repo PASS on branch and composed tree; the record's own declaration exact under the mirror and the ratchet

test_obligations.claim: the roster holds identity and nothing else; delegations name rostered seats from the threshold forward; both excluded shapes are observed refused

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR
